title: Self-Supervised Learning with Generative Adversarial Network
summary: A research project applying Conditional Tabular GAN (CTGAN) to synthesize tabular data, addressing issues like data scarcity and class imbalance during ML training. It runs SDV's CTGANSynthesizer to generate synthetic data and its evaluate_quality function to assess synthesis quality.
